messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Simulated annealing on bounded square with combinatorial local moves

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square is a 4×4 grid minus the three points on a single edge, yielding a minimum triangle area of 1/48; simulated annealing with combinatorial moves (periodic single-point displacement with reflective boundary conditions and Metropolis acceptance) will provably converge to this configuration, as it forms the unique global maximum where no single-point perturbation can locally increase the minimum area."}
